feeds.title: Washingtonian
feeds.description: The Washingtonian Magazine is the online presence of Washingtonian Magazine, a monthly lifestyle publication covering the Washington D.C. metropolitan area. The website features articles on topics such as food and drink, travel, arts and culture, real estate, and politics, with a focus on events and happenings in and around the nation's capital.

feeds.title: PoPville
feeds.description: PoPville chronicles the happenings in Washington D.C.'s neighborhoods since 2006. Like Jackie Lee's of yesteryear, PoPville has become the pulse of the nation's capital. Topics covered include quality of life, real estate, restaurants, bars, retail, architecture, gardening, pets, transit, crime and other general observations about daily life in D.C.

feeds.title: The Washington Lobbyist
feeds.description: Michael Woestehoff is the founder of The Washington Lobbyist. The Washington Lobbyist is a DC-centric blog featuring all the latest in travel, hotels, restaurants, and events.

feeds.title: DC Life Magazine
feeds.description: DCLife Magazine is a digital publication that covers news, lifestyle, and culture in Washington D.C., and the surrounding areas. The publication aims to highlight the diverse and dynamic communities that make up the D.C. region, while also providing practical information for locals and visitors alike.

feeds.title: A Touch of Teal
feeds.description: A Touch of Teal is a Washington, DC lifestyle blog and fashion blog where Katie Urban shares her travels, outfits, and home decor. A Touch of Teal is truly Katie Urban's passion project where she share the things she love, reflect on past and present experiences, and document her life.

feeds.title: Cobalt Chronicles
feeds.description: Cobalt Chronicles is a Popular DC Lifestyle blog featuring content about travels, style, delicious eats and living in our nation's capital. Ashlee Hightower is the founder and voice behind Cobalt Chronicles. She run this site and a legal contracts business, Contracts for Creatives, full time.

feeds.title: Blonde in the District Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Blonde in the District, an award winning Washington DC & Virginia life, style, beauty, and travel blog dedicated to body positivity and encouraging women to find their confidence through style.

feeds.title: The Metropolitan Girl
feeds.description: Covers articles about Washington DC fashion, travel, and lifestyle blog for millennial women. Blogger Grace Ashi's mission is to empower young women through fashion, travel, and personal growth. At Metropolitan Girl, you'll find stylish outfit inspiration, tips for exploring new places, and advice for growing both personally and professionally.

feeds.title: The Hyattsville Wire
feeds.description: The premier source for lifestyle news for Woodridge, D.C., Mount Rainier, Bladensburg, Edmonston, Brentwood, North Brentwood, Hyattsville, Riverdale Park, University Park, College Park and the greater Route 1 corridor in the suburbs of Washington, D.C., with a focus on dining, arts and culture, history, urban planning, and real estate and development.

feeds.title: Rashida Banks Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Rashida! Welcome to RashidaBanks.com! On this blog, you will find helpful, simple, and practical tips on makeup techniques, natural hairstyles, and my all time favorite thing to do DIY Home Projects! I'm huge on personal growth as well, so you'll also get encouragement on how to live your best 'free' life!

feeds.title: Cats & All That
feeds.description: A blog about life for pet lovers and other critters. Cats & All That is a blog written by writer/poet Azeena and her daughter, the Crazy Cat Lady about life in general and about the adventures of two jet setting cats who live in Washington, D.C.

feeds.title: Prime EstatePlanning Blog
feeds.description: Estate Planning in Washington DC.

feeds.title: DIEGO DOWNTOWN Blog
feeds.description: Diego Downtown is a men's fashion and lifestyle blog based in Washington, D.C.

feeds.title: Yasmina Cowan Photography Blog
feeds.description: Yasmina Cowan is a Washington DC family photographer specializing in on-location newborn, family, kids and lifestyle photography. Serving the Maryland, Washington DC and Northern Virginia areas.

feeds.title: Alicia Tenise
feeds.description: Top DC life and style blogger, Alicia Tenise, shares her travels and inspiration on fashion, beauty and home decor. Alicia like to focus on all things attainable, Alicia show you what you should invest in and what to save on to make the most out of your wardrobe, home decor, and vacations.

feeds.title: Occasionally Luxe
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lisa! I'm a self proclaimed fashionista who loves to celebrate the luxe in life! I decided to start this blog as a creative outlet for myself; professionally, I've been in a typical office environment for so long, which doesn't really provide me an avenue to express my creativity or pursue my passions directly. I'm looking forward to being able to share my interests and lifestyle with you in hopes that we can connect and inspire each other to actively celebrate all the luxe in life!

feeds.title: The DC Darlings
feeds.description: Welcome to the DC darlings! We are best friends, living in the Nation's Capitol, and we believe life is too short not to be fabulous. Follow us for the latest trends in fashion & beauty, as we share with you our favorite spots throughout the DC Metropolitan Area. We hope to bring you the best of the Washington, and anywhere else the world may take us.

feeds.title: Angelica In The City Blog
feeds.description: Angelica In The City is a source for inspiration that covers everything from travel and fitness to parenting, attainable luxury and style, home decor and more. I hope to encourage people to discover new places to get fit, delicious places to eat, exciting things to see and fun things to do in the Washington DC area and beyond.

feeds.title: K Street Magazine
feeds.description: K Street Magazine is about DC's noteworthy people, places, and happenings and has been the city's go-to online resource for all the lifestyle and event info DC needs to know to experience the real city behind the Capital City.

feeds.title: Sensible Stylista
feeds.description: Hey guys! My name's Kim, and I'm a Korean-American hustler living in the DMV area (DC/MD/VA). I work as hard as possible all day, every day to build the life of my dreams.

feeds.title: DC Girl in Pearls
feeds.description: Hello, there! I'm Lauren Anne, a twenty-something living in DC. I started DC Girl in Pearls in 2011 as a creative outlet for inspiration. I chronicle my personal style along with my kitchen and cocktail adventures.

feeds.title: Style Stamped
feeds.description: The name Style Stamped exemplifies good style, fashion, art, and fun experiences that deserves acknowledgement. A fashion blog inspiring you to put a stamp on style. Spreading inspiration through visualization, experience, and what you or I wear today. Tomorrow it may be something different, but it will always inspirational.
